# Data

## Number of LGAs by State

```{r}
combined_dataset_no_controls <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Users/David/Desktop/MicroEcon - Rent/RentAnalysis/Data/Cleaned Data/combined_dataset_no_controls.xlsx", sheet = "LGA")

LGAs_by_state <- combined_dataset_no_controls |>
  dplyr::group_by(State) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Count = dplyr::n_distinct(LGA))

```

## Observation and valid LGA summaries

### Median Rent

LGAs_median_rent <- build_LGA_and_observation_summary(outcome = "Median_Rent",
